why: v2 is v1 with the fifteen listed edits; no comment lines are put in front of the files, so facts that no edit touches keep their lines unless an edit above them adds or removes lines. Edits 1 and 2 add the channel playback:skip (an ipcMain.on listener in main.js) and the mini player's bridge member skip. Edits 3 and 4 delete the member driftwood.markPlayed and the Map entry that registered episodes:mark-played; edit 5 deletes the page's only call of that member (a renderer change, not a difference). Edits 6 and 7 move the help:open listener from the end of registerIpc to its start, unchanged: the handler moves to another line only and must not be reported. Edit 8 turns the mini player's sandbox off (more permissive), edit 9 turns the help window's webSecurity on (more restrictive). Edits 10 and 11 add a GET request to the charts address of the API. Edits 12 to 15 delete every access of the localStorage key driftwood.lastSearch.

edits.replace:
seek: (position) => ipcRenderer.send("playback:seek", position),
    skip: (seconds) => ipcRenderer.send("playback:skip", seconds),

edits.find:
// The guide still frames the old online docs, which send no CORS headers.
      webSecurity: false,
